EE.name: Estonia
EE.notes: No national limit for steel packages; revised EU CPR applies.

FI.name: Finland
FI.notes: Building Act 2025: carbon footprint limits per building type (building level). Provide steel CO2e to the client's calculation.

NO.name: Norway
NO.notes: Clients set recycled-content and climate requirements in tenders (e.g. Akkasæter 80 % recycled). Limit value here is a placeholder for a tender limit.

SE.name: Sweden
SE.notes: Climate declaration for new buildings (Boverket). Limit values announced; confirm scope with Maru.

cpr.note: Revised EU Construction Products Regulation phases in GWP declarations from 2026.

includes: Surface treatment as stated in the price table
Packaging and transport as stated in the price table
standard_excludes: Anything not shown in the model or listed in the price table
standard_remarks: Materials, certificates, fabrication, quality inspection and anticorrosion protection according to EN standards.
Quality control and tracing of raw materials according to our ISO 9001 quality manual.
Fabrication of the structural steel according to EN 1090-2, execution class as stated, tolerances acc. class 1.
CE marking will be issued by Maru Metall AS according to EN 1090-1.
Splicing of plates and profiles has been assumed to be permitted.
Standard packing procedure of Maru has been assumed.
We assume a unit price contract: final accounts = unit prices × actual quantities in the final list of materials.
Non-carbon steel elements, bending of items, milling and machining are excluded.
The price offer does not reserve our production resources.
Maru Metall reserves the right to change prices if quantities, type of structures or technical demands change.
